description: This file defines navigation-related constants, types, and functions for a UI, including tab groups, path normalization, and icon/title retrieval for tabs.

methods.name: normalizeBasePath
methods.description: Normalizes a base path string by trimming, ensuring it starts with '/', and removing trailing '/' unless it's just '/'.

methods.name: normalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a path string by trimming, ensuring it starts with '/', and removing trailing '/' unless it's just '/'.

methods.name: pathForTab
methods.description: Constructs a URL path for a given tab and optional base path.

methods.name: tabFromPath
methods.description: Determines the tab associated with a given pathname and optional base path.

methods.name: inferBasePathFromPathname
methods.description: Infers the base path from a given pathname by analyzing its segments.

methods.name: iconForTab
methods.description: Returns an icon name corresponding to a specific tab.

methods.name: titleForTab
methods.description: Returns a localized title string for a given tab.

methods.name: subtitleForTab
methods.description: Returns a localized subtitle string for a given tab.
